criteria.1.1: WHEN the Operator creates a Discount_Code whose fields are all in range, THE Code_Book SHALL hold that Discount_Code under its Code.
criteria.1.2: IF the Kind is `percent` and the Amount is outside 1–50, THEN THE Code_Book SHALL refuse the Discount_Code and stay unchanged.
criteria.1.3: IF the Kind is `fixed` and the Amount is outside 1–1,000,000, THEN THE Code_Book SHALL refuse the Discount_Code and stay unchanged.
criteria.1.4: IF the Code does not match the Code format, THEN THE Code_Book SHALL refuse the Discount_Code and stay unchanged.
criteria.1.5: IF the Min_Subtotal is outside 0–1,000,000, THEN THE Code_Book SHALL refuse the Discount_Code and stay unchanged.
criteria.1.6: IF the Code_Book already holds a Discount_Code with the same Code, THEN THE Code_Book SHALL refuse the new Discount_Code and keep the old one.
criteria.1.7: IF the Kind is not `percent` or `fixed`, or the Amount is not an integer, THEN THE Code_Book SHALL refuse the Discount_Code and stay unchanged.
criteria.2.1: WHEN the Shopper attaches a Code that is in the Code_Book, Current_Date is on or before Valid_Until, and the Subtotal is at least Min_Subtotal, THE Cart SHALL make that Discount_Code its Attached_Code.
criteria.2.2: IF the Code is not in the Code_Book, THEN THE Cart SHALL refuse the attach with reason `code_not_found`.
criteria.2.3: IF Current_Date is after Valid_Until, THEN THE Cart SHALL refuse the attach with reason `code_expired`.
criteria.2.4: IF the Subtotal is less than Min_Subtotal, THEN THE Cart SHALL refuse the attach with reason `minimum_not_met`.
criteria.2.5: IF the Cart already has an Attached_Code, THEN THE Cart SHALL refuse the attach with reason `code_already_attached`.
criteria.2.6: WHEN the Cart refuses an attach, THE Cart SHALL keep its Attached_Code as it was before the attach.
criteria.2.7: IF more than one refusal condition holds, THEN THE Cart SHALL refuse with the first reason in the order `code_not_found`, `code_already_attached`, `code_expired`, `minimum_not_met`.
criteria.3.1: WHEN the Shopper detaches the code from a Cart, THE Cart SHALL have no Attached_Code.
criteria.3.2: IF the Cart has no Attached_Code when the Shopper detaches, THEN THE Cart SHALL finish without an error.
criteria.4.1: WHILE the Attached_Code has Kind `percent`, THE Cart SHALL report Discount_Amount = floor(Subtotal × Amount / 100) cents.
criteria.4.2: WHILE the Attached_Code has Kind `fixed`, THE Cart SHALL report Discount_Amount = min(Amount, Subtotal) cents.
criteria.4.3: WHILE the Cart has no Attached_Code, THE Cart SHALL report Discount_Amount = 0 cents.
criteria.4.4: THE Cart SHALL report Amount_Due = Subtotal − Discount_Amount cents.
criteria.4.5: WHILE the Subtotal is less than the Attached_Code's Min_Subtotal, THE Cart SHALL report Discount_Amount = 0 cents, overriding 4.1 and 4.2.
criteria.4.6: WHILE Current_Date is after the Attached_Code's Valid_Until, THE Cart SHALL report Discount_Amount = 0 cents, overriding 4.1 and 4.2.
criteria.5.1: WHEN the Handler gets `PUT /carts/<id>/code` with body `{"code": <string>}` and the attach succeeds, THE Handler SHALL answer status 200 with `subtotal_cents`, `discount_cents`, and `amount_due_cents`.
criteria.5.2: IF the attach is refused, THEN THE Handler SHALL answer status 422 with body `{"error": <reason>}`.
criteria.5.3: IF the body of `PUT /carts/<id>/code` lacks `code` or `code` is not a string, THEN THE Handler SHALL answer status 400 with body `{"error": "invalid_body"}`.
criteria.5.4: WHEN the Handler gets `DELETE /carts/<id>/code`, THE Handler SHALL answer status 200 with `subtotal_cents`, `discount_cents`, and `amount_due_cents`.
criteria.5.5: WHEN the Handler gets `GET /carts/<id>`, THE Handler SHALL add `code`, `discount_cents`, and `amount_due_cents` to the existing body, with `code` null when the Cart has no Attached_Code.
criteria.5.6: IF `ctx["today"]` is missing or not a `datetime.date`, or `ctx["code_book"]` is missing, on a request to a route in Requirement 5, THEN THE Handler SHALL answer status 500 with body `{"error": "bad_context"}` before any body check.
criteria.5.7: WHEN the Handler answers status 500 with `bad_context`, THE Handler SHALL leave every Cart's lines and Attached_Code unchanged.
